title: Exact localization and identity unit law for varying-ring open extension
statement:
Let $R_n$ be arbitrary commutative rings with maps $\varphi_n:R_{n+1}\to R_n$. Use the ordinary module-system categories and operations [def-sp-varying-ring-operations]. For a scheme $X$, let $L=L_{1_X}$ be ordinary inverse image, $B=(1_X)_{!,\bullet}$ ordinary open extension, and $e_X:L\simeq\mathrm{id}$ the inverse-image identity. Define $b_X:B\simeq\mathrm{id}$ as its unit-preserving left-adjoint comparison under $B\dashv L$. Let $J_{1_X}=D(B)$, and let $j_X:J_{1_X}\simeq\mathrm{id}$ be the specified derived identity comparison adjoint to $g_X:D(L)\simeq\mathrm{id}$ under the chosen derived open adjunction. Then $j_X$ equals the localization $D(b_X)$ followed by the exact-derived identity comparison. Moreover, for the specified open compositor $j_{1_X,1_X}:J_{1_X}J_{1_X}\simeq J_{1_X1_X}$,
$$ \operatorname{transport}_{1_X1_X=1_X}\circ j_{1_X,1_X}=J_{1_X}(j_X).$$
These are equalities of derived natural transformations on all unbounded complexes of systems.
